item.title: A simpler way to keep Murph going in a group
item.summary: Funding a group is now one page with one dial, and the button shows the amount you chose.
item.details: Drag the end of the dial to set an amount, and scrolling past it leaves your choice alone. A monthly sponsorship still charges $5 at a time, up to your limit. If you cancel at checkout, you land back on the same page. The optional personal notes, songs and credits are gone.
